response.overview: Kyle Bryant and Sean Baumstark, disabled by a rare disease, embark on a grueling 200-mile ride up Umling La, the world’s highest road. Supported by a dedicated team, their epic ride mirrors their community’s 30-year battle for a breakthrough drug approval. As the team pedals, they carry the hope of thousands fighting for time, treatment, and a future.
response.title: The Highest Road
